original_ai_output.title_zh: 开罗一栋五层建筑倒塌，至少六人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃及首都开罗一栋五层建筑倒塌，紧急救援人员已找到六名遇难者遗体，其中包括三名儿童。据当地媒体报道，另有七人受伤被送往医院。救援人员周三继续在废墟中搜寻仍被困人员。

key_facts.fact: 开罗一栋五层建筑倒塌，至少六人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least six dead after 5-storey building collapses in Cairo

key_facts.fact: 救援人员找到六名遇难者遗体，其中包括三名儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Emergency crews in the Egyptian capital Cairo have recovered the bodies of six people, including three children, after the collapse of a five-storey building.

key_facts.fact: 据当地媒体报道，七人受伤被送往医院
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Seven people were taken to hospital with injuries, according to local media reports.

key_facts.fact: 救援人员周三继续在废墟中搜寻被困人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Rescuers continued to search the debris on Wednesday for anyone still trapped.

uncertainties: 伤亡人数及被困情况目前仅来自单一来源，尚未获得交叉验证
